claims.claim_text: The issuer is TradeFunded LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, per its Form C filing (issuer-reported).
The Form C lists the issuer's date of incorporation as 02-10-2026 (about 8 months before the pack cutoff), so it is a very new entity. Website listed: www.tradefunded.com.
claims.contradictions: The Form C reports a 'prior fiscal year' net income of -23,115, which is hard to reconcile with an entity incorporated 02-10-2026 unless the fiscal years or a predecessor are explained; the explanation is not in the pack.

claims.claim_text: The offering is run through intermediary OpenDeal Portal LLC (SEC file number 007-00167, CRD 283874), per the Form C.

The security offered is typed 'Other' with the description 'Units' (LLC units). The pack's checklist labels it 'equity', but the Form C does not say which rights the units carry (voting, distributions, transfer limits).
Price per unit is $0.35, with the price determination method stated as 'Arbitrary' (not set by a valuation formula).
Units offered in the target round: 214,285. Target offering amount: $74,999.75.
Units times price equals the stated target amount (consistency check).
Oversubscriptions are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis, with a maximum offering amount of $679,999.95.
The offering deadline is 12-15-2026 (about two months after the pack cutoff). A future deadline does not prove the offering is currently open; availability was not verified.

Intermediary cash compensation is the greater of $15,000 or a tiered fee: 0% on funds up to $100,000 and 6% from $100,000.01 to $5,000,000. The text is truncated in the Form C field, and an additional non-refundable $15,000 payment is mentioned but cut off.

citations.quote: the Issuer will pay the Intermediary a cash fee equal to the greater of $15,000 or a tiered calculation: 0% on funds raised up to $100,000, and 6% on funds raised from $100,000.01 to $5,000,000.

claims.claim_text: The intermediary will also receive securities equal to 2% of the total number of securities sold in the offering, which dilutes investors slightly.

citations.quote: The Intermediary will also receive compensation in the form of securities equal to two percent (2%) of the total number of the securities sold in the Offering.

claims.claim_text: Pre-revenue: the Form C reports revenue of $0.00 for the most recent fiscal year and for the prior fiscal year. Fiscal year-end dates are not stated in the XML, and no statements are in the pack.
claims.financial_period: Most recent and prior fiscal year (year-end dates not stated in pack)

claims.claim_text: Most recent fiscal year: total assets $226,885 while cash and equivalents are $0.00, so the assets are non-cash and their nature is not described in the pack. Prior fiscal year total assets were $0.00.
claims.financial_period: Most recent fiscal year (end date not stated); prior fiscal year

claims.claim_text: Reported net income was $0.00 for the most recent fiscal year and -$23,115.00 for the prior fiscal year. Reported short-term and long-term debt were $0.00 in both years.
claims.financial_period: Most recent and prior fiscal year (year-end dates not stated in pack)
claims.contradictions: A loss in the prior year followed by exactly $0 net income and $226,885 of assets in the most recent year looks internally unusual; this cannot be checked without the financial statements.

claims.claim_text: The Form C reports 0 current employees.

Christopher Price signed as Chief Executive Officer. Ryan Masten, Christopher Price and David Lojko signed as Manager Representatives on 09-16-2026. No biographies or prior experience are in the pack, so the team's relevant experience cannot be assessed.
The offering is registered for sale in many US states and territories (the Form C lists jurisdictions including CA, NY, TX and FL).

Because the issuer is pre-revenue, was incorporated in 2026, has $0 cash, and has no business description in the pack, the stage-appropriate evidence (product, traction, team record, use of proceeds) is entirely absent from the reviewed material.

critical_items.note: The Form C XML establishes the issuer, the Delaware LLC form, the intermediary and the deadline. The issuer reported all of this itself.
The Form C says 'Other: Units'. The rights attached to the units are not described in the pack. The pack's checklist label 'equity' is a classification and not contract text.
No operating agreement or subscription agreement is in the pack. The only attachment, tradef.pdf, was not parsed because it exceeds the size limit.
Only the Form C price ($0.35 per unit, arbitrary) is available. No contract text on rights, valuation, conversion or repurchase is in the pack. The units are priced directly, and no cap is evidenced.
The minimum investment is not stated. Intermediary fees paid by the issuer are in the Form C, but investor-level fees are unconfirmed.

Only Form C summary fields are in the pack. No financial statements, fiscal year-end dates or accountant report are in the pack, so the statement dates cannot be cited. The prior-year loss does not obviously fit a February 2026 incorporation.
The platform page was not verified and no closing has been reported. The deadline of 12-15-2026 alone does not prove the offering is open.

missing_information: Operative contract (LLC operating agreement and subscription agreement): unit rights, voting, distributions, transfer limits, information rights, repurchase rights. tradef.pdf (about 61.7 MB) was not parsed.
Business description, product, customers, revenue model and market (none in the reviewed pack).
Use of proceeds and what the $74,999.75 target and $679,999.95 maximum would fund.
Financial statements, fiscal year-end dates and accountant report; the nature of the $226,885 non-cash assets; the explanation of the prior-year net loss given the 02-10-2026 incorporation date.
Minimum investment amount and investor-level fees.
Valuation basis: the price is stated as 'Arbitrary', and the total units outstanding and the implied valuation are not in the pack.
Team biographies and relevant prior experience for Christopher Price, Ryan Masten and David Lojko.
Existing capitalization table and ownership, and related-party arrangements.
Platform page confirmation that the offering is open and any reported closings.
The remainder of the truncated intermediary compensation text (the additional non-refundable $15,000 payment).
